GL-1300

Months of profiling from a single deployment.

COMPLETE SYSTEM

Specify more than
the vehicle.

The manufacturer describes a low-drag, low-noise, low-power design built from six modular units, supporting different sensors and power modules. This site presents the glider for civil ocean observation only.

Confirm in the delivered scope

  • Glider, batteries and selected sensors
  • Communication, mission planning and data software
  • Launch and recovery equipment
  • Spares, battery shipping arrangements and training

Standard, optional and custom items must be listed separately in the quotation.

QUESTIONS

Before you specify the GL-1300.

How long can it stay at sea?

With only the CTD running in profile-glide mode, the catalogue lists at least 120 days per deployment. Additional sensors reduce endurance.

How is it powered and shipped?

It uses primary (non-rechargeable) lithium batteries of at least 500 Ah. These are dangerous goods for transport, so shipping is planned per project.

PROCUREMENT

Prepare the next review.

Agree the site conditions, acceptance test, delivery scope and support responsibilities. Product names and rated figures alone are not a project specification.
